correctness.rationale: In characteristic not two the commuting equations reduce to a rank-at-most-one degree-one tuple and the exterior-product constraints in degrees four and six. Explicit formulas alpha_j=c_j alpha_1+v wedge eta_j, beta_j=c_j beta_1+alpha_1 wedge eta_j+v wedge zeta_j parametrize the entire rank-one stratum, with dimension 48s+16. The zero-degree-one stratum is the isotropic-tuple locus for a nondegenerate alternating pairing on Lambda^3(k^6), hence irreducible through a surjective Lagrangian-incidence resolution; isotropic rank strata give dimensions 58s-C(s,2) through s=10 and 48s+55 above it. The positive dimension gap proves exactly two components. Counting rank-one 6-by-s matrices and isotropic finite-field tuples yields the displayed point-count formula. The standard-library checker passed 1006 finite tests and matches the old s=2 polynomial, without purporting to prove generality.
